item.title: How to Redeem Codes in 99 Nights in the Forest
item.description: Most codes in 99 Nights in the Forest are redeemed in the Lobby with just four taps. One special code — yay fishing — works differently, and it is explained at the bottom of this page. Redeeming lobby codes Launch the game and stay in the Lobby. Do not join a server yet. Open the shop / gem menu — click the diamond icon in the bottom-left corner of the screen.
